concepts.gloss_en: spring/wellspring — symbol of Chochmah (wisdom), the source from which intellect flows

members.note: מַעְיָן = spring/fountain, equated with חכמה per Song 4 'מעין גנים'

concepts.gloss_en: 'in the eye' — preposition ב + עַיִן (eye); context of memory dwelling in the eye and guarding against 'evil eye'

members.note: בָּעַיִן = 'in the eye'; head noun is עַיִן (eye), not מעין (spring). Different word entirely despite surface similarity

notes: These are NOT variants of one another. מעין = spring (m-ʿ-y-n, wisdom source); בעין = ב + עַיִן = 'in the eye' (memory/vision context, Torah 54). The mechanical clitic signal is a false positive: the shared letters are coincidental, the underlying nouns differ.
